name: The Dillinger Escape Plan
description:
'''The Dillinger Escape Plan''' was an American [[metalcore]] band from [[Morris Plains, New Jersey]], formed in 1997. For much of their history, the band's lineup consisted of lead vocalist [[Greg Puciato]], guitarist [[Ben Weinman]], bassist [[Liam Wilson]] and either [[Chris Pennie]] or [[Billy Rymer]] on drums. The band's use of [[Consonance and dissonance|dissonance]], [[odd time signatures]], [[polyrhythms]] and unconventional drum patterns became a staple of their sound, although later albums incorporated more melody and influences from a range of genres.

The band underwent several lineup changes, with Weinman remaining the band's only founding member. Original vocalist [[Dimitri Minakakis]] performed on their debut album ''[[Calculating Infinity]]'' (1999), which has been noted by critics as a landmark release in [[hardcore punk]] and [[heavy metal music]]. The album has achieved a cult status selling well over 100,000 copies, which made the band the highest-selling artist on [[Relapse Records|Relapse]] at the time.

Puciato became the Dillinger Escape Plan's vocalist in 2001, and the band became known for their extreme live performances. Their fifth album, ''[[One of Us Is the Killer]]'' (2013), became the band's highest-charting in the U.S. at number 25. In 2016, the band announced their final album ''[[Dissociation (album)|Dissociation]]'', and their final shows took place at New York City's [[Terminal 5 (venue)|Terminal 5]] in December 2017.

The Dillinger Escape Plan has won various nominations from award shows and publications such as the [[PLUG Independent Music Awards]], ''[[Kerrang!]]'', [[Revolver (magazine)|''Revolver'']] and ''[[Metal Hammer Golden Gods Awards|Metal Hammer]]''. In 2017, the band won an [[Association of Independent Music|AIM]] Award for "Outstanding Contribution to Music".

From 2023 to 2026, the band reunited with Minakakis instead of Puciato to perform their early work in celebration of ''Calculating Infinity''<nowiki/>'s 25th anniversary.
